method: The research container could not open the site itself (outbound fetches are refused), so the features come from web-search results of the site's own pages (listed in sources) and from how the product is publicly known to work; a feature not confirmed by a search result says so in its detail. Verse's side was read from this repository's source.

features.name: Git, Mercurial and Subversion hosting
features.detail: unlimited repositories of any type per project
features.verse_evidence: /g/ holds snippets in a link; no repositories

features.name: Repository browser
features.verse_evidence: shows a GitHub file read-only (?gh=) with line numbers; no history or blame

features.name: Code review on commits / merge requests
features.verse_evidence: "What changed" diff between an edited copy and its original; no comments

features.name: Time tracking
features.detail: log hours, billed and unbilled, estimates against tickets

features.name: Project files and discussions
features.detail: upload files, discuss in the project
features.verse_evidence: up to 8 files per gist (lib/gist.js MAX_FILES); no discussion

features.name: Users, teams and permissions
features.verse_evidence: no accounts by design; a passphrase locks a gist

features.name: Paid plans
features.detail: Hobbyist £20/month (6 projects, 10 users), Studio £50, Agency £110, Corporate £220

verse_extra: Nothing stored: the gist lives in the link
Passphrase lock that never leaves the page
Edit a copy and see what changed
Open any public GitHub file as a gist with lines lit (?gh=...&L=)
gaps: Code review on commits / merge requests
